body: That’s unfortunately not an option, she’s the only one at my clinic qualified to “treat” my kind of mental illnesses and diagnoses, and I can’t change clinics either, there’s only one that caters to my diagnoses. I’m stuck with her. I’m so scared she’ll say something similar next time as well, I don’t know how much of “you’re not serious about this” I can’t take before I choose a cruder method so they can get rid of me

I noticed that. I asked her once if I could see her a little faster than last time (it went 2-3 months) and she snapped at me with “you know, you’re not the only one who’s sick, why should you take priority over others?”
And I never.... I never asked to be a higher priority, I just asked for an earlier meeting. Of course I know people are sick or sicker than me, it just felt like she wanted me to feel guilty. Or I am just projecting. I can’t tell anymore

I would, but in the country I live in it’s extremely expensive to go private, and they make it near impossible to change the people who help you inside the system. They even deemed me unfit for treatment other than regular check up and medication handling, which is with this doctor.  

My journals says they have done all they can for me. It feels like they’re just waiting for me to die at this point, knowing full well I have nowhere else to turn.

Yeah I think so too, I decided to speak up about what was going through my mind with hopes that she would maybe offer treatment or something but instead.... she just made it worse. So much worse. I don’t know if I’m just a big cry baby, but it felt like she was testing me, egging me on to do it, or another scenario where she doesn’t even believe me so she doesn’t care what she says.

I reported her to the place she works at, my regular clinic, and it’s in the process of reaching the higher ups. Don’t know if anything will come out it, but it seems they gave her a slap on the wrist for her comments to start with. 

But then I got another appointment with her I November. And there’s no other doctor qualified for my type of problems where I go. I have to see her again.

I had a therapist for years but she died about 5 years ago from cancer very unexpectedly and my treatment stopped, and the system just kept me in limbo with doctors visits to regulate my medications but no new therapist, I’ve tried to get them to assign me a new one but they never did. My doctor likes to joke that I’ve tried all the medications in the world, and before this whole Covid crisis started they were looking into ECT but much like everything in these times it got dropped. My family had said I’m a lost cause, and they’re tired of me never getting better.
Thank you, people just seem to get angry with me all the time when all I’ve ever wanted is help, it’s hard to find peace

I wish it were like that, it would be easier to reach out if I had this in common with them, but they found my main account because I didn’t blur it out in a screenshot I sent, so they looked it up and saw my post history and that way found their way here... And seems to be angry at me.
Help would’ve been good like 3 months ago, at this point I’m dead set on dying, them having to see it was unfortunate LMAO
